title: The speed of light as a Lieb--Robinson velocity
html: The speed of light c_q is the ratio of spatial to temporal information transfer within a light cone — a q-dependent quantity, not a postulated constant set to 1 by definition. Evaluated as the contact affine coordinate Z = \alpha_H / (\iota_\xi\alpha) on the q-connection, it measures the ratio of horizontal spatial diffusion to vertical quantum spin. This is the Lieb--Robinson velocity of the causal cone: the number of spatial information fibres correlated per unit of Reeb phase advance in one discrete f_q-iteration.
